_rationale: 500k initial, 60k/yr flat spending (0% yearly decrease) starting at age 60. No growth, no inflation, Florida (no state tax). Federal tax applies on withdrawals above standard deduction (~15.7k). Effective annual drawdown ~65.7k. Depletes faster than the 5% decrease scenario (age 68 vs 70) because spending never decays. 0% success rate.
